items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: my nucleus is my quartet. Hamid Drake and Jaribu Shahid, as a trio. I mean those two guys are pretty much my nucleus in everything that I’m doing right now.

ctx.x: The nature of the business seems to be that everybody’s got multiple projects. I can imagine how hard it must be to get the people you want for either recording, or to do those concerts.

Yeah. Well you know what I’ve done is I have a nucleus and my nucleus is my quartet. Hamid Drake and Jaribu Shahid, as a trio. I mean those two guys are pretty much my nucleus in everything that I’m doing right now. So when the rhythm section is strong, you seem like you could build anything around it. It’s like you’ve got your motor and you’ve got your steering wheel and you’ve got — all you needs is some seats and a chassis. And then the ornaments and horns and brake lights you can put around it.
